segments.text: Rahul Verma: We decided to version the API under /api/v1 prefix. This is consistent with the REST versioning convention we agreed on in the kickoff.
Nisha Patel: The pgvector dimension mismatch issue that Alex Rivera reported has been identified. The fix is to enforce 1536 dimensions as the standard embedding size across the pipeline.
Kiran Das: I will write the API integration test suite covering all endpoints. The task is due by September 20th.

Rahul Verma: We have a recurring authentication token expiry issue. Users are being logged out every 10 minutes instead of every 24 hours. This was first reported by Alex Rivera and has occurred twice now.
